correctness.rationale: All finite-abelian and character hypotheses are explicit. The proof expands the exact autocorrelation into subgroup, impulse, and two cross terms. Orthogonality gives q survivors per nonzero subgroup shift and q/r possible zero-delay cancellations. Disjoint cross cosets r>2 yield 2hN entries; merged r=2 cosets yield N/o(x) character-zero fibers controlled by ord(-bar z/z) and ord(x). This proves the exact formulas, the attainable support list and all optimizer equalities. The sharp bound uses ord(x)>=2 with an exact iff. The packaged cyclotomic checker independently computed 80 finite comparisons, including primitive eighth-root and square-root phases. No inference from finite tests to infinite group classes is made.

value.rationale: The natural minimally perturbed subgroup indicator is the canonical finite Gabor concentration extremizer. The theorem supplies its exact support response for every finite abelian group, a complete arithmetic phase-order staircase when y+H is an involution, a disjoint support threshold distinguishing order-two quotients from all higher orders, and a sharp universal bound with complete extremizer characterization. Exact time-frequency support is a mathematically motivated invariant, and the case classification resolves it nontrivially beyond generic uncertainty bounds. No robustness under approximate zeros is claimed.
